theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_translation_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (R C : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet F volume → (∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) (R + 1) → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in F, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g y ≤ C) → ∀ h : Rn N, ‖h‖ ≤ 1 → volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff ((fun y ↦ y + h) ⁻¹' F) F) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
